prompt_en: Create a photorealistic cinematic editorial photograph inside a flooded botanical genetics archive at blue hour. Two unmistakably adult biological women, both visually derived from the supplied portrait’s oval face, warm brown eyes, and long dark wavy hair, stand across a transparent tissue-culture console. Use the supplied portrait solely as facial appearance inspiration, without asserting that either generated woman is the same real person. They share closely related facial structure while retaining individual freckles, hair arrangement, and expression. One has just stepped from a condensation-covered growth cradle as the other aligns her palm on a scanner; paired DNA lineage projections and matched bioreactor records visibly connect them. The source person and biological clone share one documented genomic lineage; living skin damp hair breath on glass and natural hands establish organic humanity. Reeds and laboratory vines cut through shallow reflective water. Cool archival light and a narrow amber emergency beam create shared reflections across both women, the console, and the water. Use a medium-wide eye-level composition with both faces readable and the original-and-clone relationship carried by biological provenance, not by machine parts.
